text: A primed siphon can move water over a high point to an outlet below the source reservoir. The difference in water levels supplies the gravitational drive.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Hughes and Gurung, Exploring the boundary between a siphon and barometer in a hypobaric chamber, Scientific Reports 4, 4741 (2014); https://www.nature.com/articles/srep04741. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: Pressure near the top of an ordinary siphon is below ambient pressure. Lowering the ambient pressure can make the water boil at the crest and interrupt continuous flow.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Hughes and Gurung, Exploring the boundary between a siphon and barometer in a hypobaric chamber, Scientific Reports 4, 4741 (2014); https://www.nature.com/articles/srep04741. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: Special experiments with prepared water have operated siphons above the usual barometric height limit. A liquid can sustain tension, but bubbles and cavitation often limit ordinary setups.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Boatwright, Hughes and Barry, The height limit of a siphon, Scientific Reports 5, 16790 (2015); https://www.nature.com/articles/srep16790. Consulted 2026-10-13.
